blockers: The exact anchor contract is failed: reported ground-anchor drift is 1.0px, while the requirement is 0px across every frame.
At native 1x, the silhouette reads as a broad orange barrel over thin, disconnected stick legs. It is top-heavy and does not convincingly communicate grounded physical weight.
The face is a smooth low-information oval with a cap-like hair mass and ambiguous features. At 1x it collapses into a mannequin-like head.
Dark lower garments, vambraces, and greaves merge into each other and the dark background. Small specular highlights are not a reliable material-separation strategy.
The idle strip is effectively a repeated standing pose. Breathing, pelvic compression, settle, and gear response are not readable at native scale.
The locomotion cycles use generic limb alternation with weak hip and shoulder counter-rotation. Long thin legs and tiny feet make the motion read as sliding rather than planted walking.
The signature strip does not clearly stage a heavy buckler or impact action. Anticipation, low center of mass, thrust, recoil, overshoot, and settle are not distinct.
The pauldron, buckler, and vambraces appear largely rigidly attached during motion instead of behaving as weighted secondary masses with lag and overshoot.
high_value_changes: Apply a per-frame anchor correction after rendering: determine the lowest solid foot pixel and force it to Y=176 without scaling or cropping the character.

Redesign the lower-body silhouette from the feet upward. Give Agnes wider thighs, a clearer pelvis-to-skirt transition, thicker boots, and visibly planted foot shapes so the broad torso has a credible support structure.
Replace the near-blank orange torso slab with readable armor planes and establish stepped value separation between skin, hair, cuirass, bronze gear, buckler, vambraces, and greaves.
Redesign the hairline, brow, eyes, nose, and mouth as deliberate stylized planes that survive at 1x; eliminate the smooth featureless face.
Rebuild the idle as a visible compression-and-release cycle: pelvic shift, torso breathing, shoulder counter-motion, pauldron lag, and a subtle buckler pendulum.

Reanimate all eight walk directions around explicit contact, passing, down, and up poses. Preserve planted feet, add hip/shoulder counter-rotation, and prevent the torso from remaining a rigid floating block.
Rebuild the signature gesture around a clear buckler wind-up, full-body weight transfer, impact compression, recoil, and controlled settle. The shield and pauldron should overshoot independently.
Audit side and rear silhouettes so Agnes retains a distinct asymmetric gear profile instead of collapsing into the same orange torso and dark limb pattern from every view.
optional_notes: The 111.6px standing height is within the <=128px limit; the sheet annotation reports 111.0px, so the measurement display should be reconciled.
The 105 rendered frames provide coverage, but frame count does not compensate for weak pose progression or unreadable contacts.
The technical validation flag conflicts with the stricter stated anchor requirement; the 1.0px drift must be treated as a failure.
regressions_from_previous: Round-01 visual sheets and frame metrics were not supplied, so regression status is unverified.
strongest_improvements: The asymmetric pauldron and buckler provide partial identity cues in the static silhouette.
The broad torso establishes the intended physical archetype more clearly than a narrow generic adventurer would.
The candidate includes front, side, rear, diagonal, idle, locomotion, and gesture coverage, so the remaining work is a focused redesign rather than missing animation content.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild Agnes's locomotion and signature gesture from an exact planted-foot rig, using visible pelvis-driven weight transfer and full-body buckler impact mechanics instead of animating the current rigid torso over thin sliding legs.
